# Trimble Maps RouteReporter API (CoPilot trips)

- **Product:** Trimble Maps RouteReporter API (CoPilot trips) (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Auth token from POST /identity/v2/token (Trimble Maps API key). Declared security schemes: AuthToken.
- **Access:** CoPilot RouteReporter customers.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Maps API key with RouteReporter access; trip data includes driver locations, which are personal data.
- **Documented servers:** `https://routereporterservice.trimblemaps.com`, `https://routereporterservice.az.trimblemaps.com`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/routereporter](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/routereporter.json) (RouteReporter API, version ). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/route-reporter/routereporter-api/.

## Authenticate RouteReporter

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/identity/v2/token` | `excluded`: safety: signs in, issues, renews, validates or revokes credentials, or stores a password or client secret; agents never handle credentials (as for Trimble Identity) | Authenticate using an API key and retrieve an authentication token. | body: application/json |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/v2/gpspings` | `reference` | Retrieve GPS pings associated with a specific trip by copilotTripId or externalTripId. | body: application/*+json, application/json, text/json |

## Get Multiple Trips

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/trips` | `reference` | Retrieve an array of all CoPilot trips associated with a given ExternalTripId. (Limit of 100 requests per minute.) | externalTripId (query); pageNumber (query) |
